SELECT DATE_FORMAT(T0.BALANCE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as balanceDate, T1.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, T1.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, T0.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, T4.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, T0.BAL_FLAG as balFlag, T0.O_AMT as oAmt FROM BOK_BALANCE T0 JOIN BOK_BOOKSET T1 ON T0.BOOKSET_ID = T1.BOOKSET_ID JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE T3 ON T0.BALANCE_DATE = T3.BOOKSET_DATE AND T1.BOOKSET_ID = T3.BOOKSET_ID JOIN BOK_SUBJECT T4 ON T0.SUBJECT_NO = T4.SUBJECT_NO AND T1.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = T4.BOOKSET_ID WHERE T0.O_AMT != 0 AND T2.FINPROD_ID IN (
SELECT A.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT A JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND B.BUSI_TYPE IN (17, 21, 27) AND B.PS = 'C5'
UNION ALL SELECT C.FINPROD_ID FROM (SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, SUM( (case when B.PS = 'C1' then 1 when B.PS = 'C2' then 1 when B.PS = 'C3' then 1 when B.PS = 'C10' then 1 else -1 end) * B.PRIN_AMT) AS REMAINAMT FROM FIN_PRODUCT A JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND B.BUSI_TYPE IN (17, 21, 27) AND B.PS IN ('C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4', 'C5', 'C6', 'C10') GROUP BY A.FINPROD_ID) C WHERE REMAINAMT <= 0
)
AND T0.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{booksetId}
AND T2.MDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{bookDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
